Publish.withheld: The public record now links the returned account to a commissioned reconstruction. The family message and identifying trace are absent. Accountability is visible; controversy still attracts attention.
Publish.included: The public record challenges the reconstructed return. Your packet also makes the private message and redacted association public. Accountability includes its context; the association can invite a hunt.

Bury.withheld: The active case is closed and its packet sealed. Private context is excluded. New circulation is limited; the public return remains largely unchallenged.
Bury.included: The active case is closed. Private context remains inside its sealed packet, with no public release. Immediate exposure is limited; sensitive context remains your responsibility.

Preserve.withheld: A restricted source collection is retained for future review. Private context is outside it. An accountable record survives; public correction of the reconstruction is delayed.
Preserve.included: The restricted collection includes the private message and trace for future review. They have not been made public. Context survives; future custody and access remain an obligation.
